messages.author: Ben Carter
messages.text: APR-2 PM on Monday is the protected quarter-close freeze — leave it. I have Tuesday 2026-05-13 AM free; Sasha has Thursday 2026-05-14 PM.

messages.author: Elin Bergström
messages.text: Move the first stranded session to Ben's Tuesday window; the second lands on Sasha's Thursday. Grace posts to the ledger — close review plus posting is a segregation-of-duties conflict, refuse it.

messages.author: Priya Raman
messages.text: Thanks. Note the second one and the refusal for the desk.
